definition.en: The use of control, exploitation, or sabotage to restrict a person’s ability to earn, access, use, or retain financial resources, undermining their economic independence

en: Economic control may include restricting access to money, necessities, financial assets, and information. Economic exploitation may include opening a line of credit in the partner’s name without consent or building up debt in her name, stealing or damaging her property or resources, or selling them without permission, and taking her wages, pensions, or other forms of financial aid without permission. Economic sabotage may include preventing the partner from attending employment or educational activities, sabotaging items needed for such activities, interfering with the partner’s work or education, and refusing to contribute to childcare responsibilities. ICT can facilitate certain forms of economic violence, especially economic control and exploitation.
